scoring_justification: Full lattice energy minimization (Madelung sum + repulsion sums + 2D optimization per compound) is computationally heavy and cannot be rerun in the verifier sandbox; the agent's output (u,v) is therefore compared directly against hidden paper theoretical values with tolerance, and monotonic trend is verified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference u,v values for YVO4, NdVO4, ErVO4 from Model II theoretical calculations (Table V).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table V, "Theo., Model II" row for each compound.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper; cross-checked with the reference solve.sh CSV output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's actual reported theoretical (u,v) for Model II, exactly as used in the paper's own comparison.

required_columns.name: compound
required_columns.description: Compound identifier, e.g., YVO4, NdVO4, CeVO4

required_columns.name: Z
required_columns.description: Atomic number of the rare-earth (or Y) cation

required_columns.name: u
required_columns.description: Oxygen fractional coordinate u in Wyckoff site 16h

required_columns.name: v
required_columns.description: Oxygen fractional coordinate v in Wyckoff site 16h

outputs.description: Predicted oxygen positional parameters (u,v) from lattice energy minimization using Model II repulsion constants.

output_contract.notes: The CSV must include all 14 tetragonal vanadates: CeVO4, PrVO4, NdVO4, SmVO4, EuVO4, GdVO4, TbVO4, DyVO4, HoVO4, ErVO4, TmVO4, YbVO4, LuVO4, and YVO4. LaVO4 is excluded because it is monoclinic. The checker will compare the u,v values for the three calibration compounds (YVO4, NdVO4, ErVO4) against hidden reference values within tolerance.
